about.title: About Kéktúra tracker
about.description: A personal tracker for the Országos Kéktúra, Hungary's National Blue Trail: mark the stamps you have collected and see how much of the trail you have walked.
about.how1: Mark the official stamping places you have collected, in any order.
about.how2: A stretch between two neighbouring places counts as walked only when both of its stamps are collected. The blue line on the map, your kilometres and your percentage all come from these stretches.
about.how3: Some places have alternative stamps, for example a pub and a tourist office in the same town. Collecting any one of them marks the place.
about.how4: Extra stamps (castles, museums, other hiking movements near the trail) are tracked separately and never count towards the official places.
about.sourceMtsz: Stamping points, route and stage table, published by MTSZ (the Hungarian Hiking Association).
about.sourceHeyjoe: The community list of extra stamps near the trail.
about.sourceOsm: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; the map is drawn with MapLibre.
about.independent: Kéktúra tracker is an independent project and is not affiliated with MTSZ.
about.data1: You sign in with Google; the app never sees your Google password. It stores your account (the email and name from your Google profile), the stamps you mark with their dates, and the messages you send through the feedback form, which are delivered to the developer together with your email if you are signed in.
about.data2: Cookies keep you signed in. Your browser also remembers display choices, such as which stages are open and which map layers are on.
about.data3: You can delete your account and all your stamps at any time on the <account>Account</account> page. Feedback messages you have already sent are kept, but are no longer linked to you.
about.contactText: Found a bug or have an idea for the tracker? Send it through the <feedback>feedback form</feedback>.
about.data4: If you connect with friends, they can see your display name and your stage-by-stage progress (official stamps, kilometres, stages). They cannot see your stamp dates or extra stamps. You can stop sharing your progress with a friend at any time on the Friends page.
